Brown Derby Cobb salad cups.make_ahead: Components up to 1 day ahead; fill just before serving

steps.text: Poach the chicken for 12 minutes, cool and dice.
Fry the bacon until crisp and crumble. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop.
Dice the avocado and tomatoes.
Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar and Dijon mustard with a pinch of salt for the vinaigrette.
Fill the lettuce leaves with everything, scatter over the blue cheese and spoon over the vinaigrette.

Flamingo steak Diane.make_ahead: Flatten the steaks and chop the shallots up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; sear and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Flatten the steaks and sear hot for 2 minutes a side, then rest.
In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, then add a splash of the stock and the balsamic vinegar and let it bubble hard.
Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, remaining stock and cream and reduce.
Return the steaks to coat in the sauce.

Virginia Hill's gin rickey.make_ahead: Best made to order; chill the non-alcoholic gin and soda water up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fill four highball glasses with ice.
Add the non-alcoholic gin and the juice of half a lime to each and drop in the squeezed shell.
Top with soda water.

Frank Vitale's linguine with clams.make_ahead: Purge the clams in salted water up to 4 hours ahead and keep them chilled; cook the pasta and steam the clams on the night

steps.text: Soak the clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge, then rinse.
Gently fry the garlic and chilli in some of the olive oil, add the clams, verjuice and water, cover and steam for 4 minutes until open.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with parsley and more olive oil.

Fuhgeddaboudit tiramisu.make_ahead: Make 1 day ahead, keep chilled; best overnight

steps.text: Whisk the yolks and sugar until pale, then fold in the mascarpone.
Whip the egg whites stiff and fold into the cream.
Mix the espresso with the vanilla extract, dip the biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish.
Dust with cocoa and chill overnight.

Auction house gin and elderflower collin.n: Auction house gin and elderflower collins (alcohol-free)
Auction house gin and elderflower collin.make_ahead: Peel the cucumber ribbons up to 3 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; shake with the non-alcoholic gin and top with soda to order

steps.text: Peel 8 long ribbons from the cucumber and curl two into each of four tall glasses, then fill with ice.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain over the glasses, top with soda and add a sprig of mint.

Captain Dickson's fish tacos.make_ahead: Soak the onion in the lime juice up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; make the batter and fry the fish just before serving so the soda water stays fizzy

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and ice-cold soda water to a batter.
Dip the flathead strips in the batter and fry in the oil at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.

Spring break frozen mango margarita.make_ahead: Juice the oranges and limes up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; blend with the frozen mango and ice just before serving

steps.text: Rub a lime wedge around the rims of the glasses and dip in sea salt flakes.
Finely zest one orange, then juice both oranges and four of the limes.
Blend the mango, orange juice and zest, lime juice, sugar syrup and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into the glasses and garnish with wheels cut from the last lime.

Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding.n: Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding
Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding.make_ahead: Salt the beef the night before

steps.text: Salt the beef and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside, then rest.
Peel and chop the potatoes and roast them in some of the oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C until puffed.
Blast the beef at 260C for 10 minutes. Reduce the stock with the balsamic vinegar in the roasting pan for a jus.
Steep the tea bags in the non-alcoholic gin for an hour, then remove.
Dissolve the honey in the hot water. Juice the lemons.
Shake the tea-infused gin, lemon juice, honey syrup and egg whites hard without ice, then add ice and shake again.
Strain into chilled coupes and twist lemon peel over each.

Date night steak.make_ahead: Bake the potato layers up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; sear and roast the steaks and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly.
Layer with cream in a dish, season with salt and pepper and bake at 180C until tender.
Season the steaks and sear hard in butter.
Roast at 200C until the centre reaches 54C, then rest.
Deglaze the pan with the stock and vinegar and reduce until glossy.
Char the asparagus and serve with the steak and sauce.

Strangé's French 75.make_ahead: Make the sugar syrup up to 1 week ahead and squeeze the lemons up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; shake and top with alcohol-free sparkling wine to order

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in a little warm water for a quick sugar syrup and cool, and juice the lemons.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice and strain into four flutes.
Top each with cold alcohol-free sparkling wine and add a lemon twist.
Simmer the sauerkraut with the apple juice, vinegar, grated apple and caraway.
Grill the bratwurst slowly until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss in butter.
Serve together.

ingredients.item: lemon, peeled zest, for the syrup

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and lemon zest, then cool and strain.
Add a spoon of syrup and a squeeze of lemon to each of 4 chilled tall mugs.
Pour in the alcohol-free wheat beer slowly, tilting the mug, then straighten to build a thick head.
Hang a lemon wheel on each rim.

Sam's Tribeca loft pasta.make_ahead: Make the sausage and cream sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; reheat, boil the rigatoni and toss together

steps.text: Boil the rigatoni in water with a good pinch of salt until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, remove the sausage skins, crumble the meat and brown it in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the stock and lemon juice and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated parmesan.

Molly's studio mulled pinot noir.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; mix with the juice and spices and warm gently to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then remove.
Pour the grape juice and tea into a saucepan with the orange peel, the juice of half the orange, cinnamon, star anise, cloves and honey.
Warm over low heat without boiling.
Strain into mugs and add a thin slice from the rest of the orange to each.

Kodiak Valley gruyère fondue.make_ahead: Grate the cheeses up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; boil the potatoes and make the fondue on the night

steps.text: Boil the baby potatoes in salted water until tender.
Rub a heavy pot with a halved garlic clove.
Heat the stock and verjuice until just simmering.
Toss the grated gruyère and the grated emmental with the cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth.
Stir in the lemon juice and nutmeg.
Keep warm over a burner and serve with the cubed baguette, the potatoes and cornichons.

Chernobly citrus ginger fizz.make_ahead: Simmer, cool and strain the ginger syrup up to 1 week ahead and juice the citrus the day before; build over ice with the soda water to serve

steps.text: Simmer the sliced ginger with the sugar and the water for 10 minutes, cool and strain.
Juice the lemon and one lime, and cut the other lime into wheels.
Fill the tall glasses with ice.
Add the ginger syrup, the lemon juice and the lime juice to each.
Top with the soda water, stir and add a lime wheel and mint sprig.

365-day project boeuf bourguignon.make_ahead: Better made 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Dry the beef and brown it in batches with the lardons.
Soften the carrots, onion and garlic in the same pot.
Return the meat, add the stock, grape juice, vinegar, thyme and bay leaves and bring to a simmer.
Braise covered at 160C for 3 hours until the beef is tender.
Glaze the pearl onions and mushrooms in the butter and stir through at the end.

Burgundy kir with crème de cassis.n: Burgundy kir with crème de cassis (alcohol-free)
Burgundy kir with crème de cassis.make_ahead: Chill the juice up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the white grape juice with the verjuice in a bottle or jug and chill for 2 hours (included in cook time).
Pour the blackcurrant cordial into wine glasses, top slowly with the cold grape mix so it blends from the bottom, and drop a blackberry in each. Serve before the bourguignon.

Santa's shop mince pies with orange crea.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream
Santa's shop mince pies with orange crea.make_ahead: Bake the pies up to 2 days ahead, airtight, and warm in a 160C oven for 5 minutes; whip the orange juice cream on the day

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and a tablespoon of the orange juice.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

Covent Garden mulled wine.make_ahead: Steep the tea and warm everything with the spices up to 1 day ahead, then chill; reheat gently to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then remove.
Pour the grape juice, apple juice and tea into a saucepan with the orange juice, sugar, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and one sliced orange.
Warm gently, keeping it under a simmer.
Ladle into heatproof glasses with a wheel cut from the second orange.

Fred Gailey's New York pot roast.n: Fred Gailey's New York pot roast
Fred Gailey's New York pot roast.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Sear the beef all over in the oil.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, stock, balsamic vinegar and enough water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes for the last hour.
Slice and serve with the juices.

Christmas pudding.make_ahead: Pudding can be steamed up to 1 week ahead

steps.text: Soak the fruit in the orange juice overnight.
Mix with the butter, sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and mixed spice.
Pack into a greased basin and cover.
Steam.
Warm the golden syrup and pour over the pudding at the table.
Serve with custard.

Angie's family pineapple upside-down cak.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep covered at room temperature; warm briefly before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C.
Melt some of the butter with the brown sugar, pineapple juice and vanilla in a 23cm tin and lay the fresh pineapple rings on top.
Beat the rest of the butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs, then the self-raising flour and the milk.
Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and turn out.
Serve warm with the chilled coconut cream.

Pineapple mint rum crush.make_ahead: Cut the pineapple and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; muddle, shake and top with soda to order

steps.text: Mix the salt with a little chilli powder and rim the glasses.
For each drink, muddle the pineapple chunks, a few mint leaves, the brown sugar syrup and the lime juice in a shaker.
Add the pineapple juice and a drop of vanilla extract, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice.
Top each glass with soda water.

Chuck and Teddy's storm chowder.make_ahead: Make the chowder with the fish stock up to the milk step, up to 1 day ahead, and chill it with the clams; reheat, then stir in the cream, clams and thyme to serve

steps.text: Steam the clams open in the fish stock, then strain the liquid.
Render the bacon, then add the onion, celery and potato.
Add the clam liquid and milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream, clams and thyme.

Dr Cawley's brandy Alexander.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the syrup, cream and ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Chill four coupe glasses.
For each drink, measure 30ml cold tea, 15ml chocolate syrup, 40ml thickened cream and a drop of vanilla extract into a shaker.
Shake each drink with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into the coupes and grate nutmeg over the top.

Amelia's slow-cooked stew.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the shanks in the oil.
Soften the onion and carrots.
Add the stock, vinegar, tomatoes and rosemary, return the shanks, cover and braise at 160C.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter.

Dook dook dook honey brandy nightcap.n: Dook dook dook honey brandy nightcap (alcohol-free)
Dook dook dook honey brandy nightcap.make_ahead: Infuse the milk with the cinnamon and orange peel up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat, whisk and finish with nutmeg

steps.text: Warm the milk with the honey, cinnamon, vanilla and orange peel until steaming without boiling.
Infuse, then remove the cinnamon and peel.
Whisk until frothy and pour into four mugs.
Finish with nutmeg.

Beer-battered onion rings with malt aiol.n: Beer-battered onion rings with malt aioli
Beer-battered onion rings with malt aiol.make_ahead: Cut the onions and mix the malt aioli up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the onions into 1cm rings and separate.
Whisk flour, baking powder and salt with the cold alcohol-free beer until just smooth.
Dust the rings in flour, dip in batter and fry in the oil in batches at 180C until golden, salting straight away.
Mix the mayonnaise with malt vinegar and crushed garlic for the dip.

Charlene's bar black and tan.make_ahead: Chill the cans and the pint glasses up to 1 day ahead; pour just before serving so the layers hold

steps.text: Chill four pint glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Pour the pale ale into each glass, tilting it so the head stays small.
Hold a spoon upside down just above the pale ale and pour the stout slowly over the back of it so it floats in a dark layer.
Serve straight away before the layers mix.

Prancing Pony pie.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in the oil, then soften the onions with the thyme.
Add the stock and Worcestershire sauce and braise until the beef is tender.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a pie dish, top with pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and cook the peas.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then remove.
Warm the apple juice and tea with the honey, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg until steaming, never boiling.
Whisk the yolks, whisk in a ladle of the hot mix, then whisk back into the pan with the butter and stir until slightly thickened.
Pour into tankards.

Fisherman's Wharf prawns.make_ahead: Slice the garlic and chilli up to 1 day ahead; the prawns and verjuice sauce are cooked just before serving

steps.text: Slice the garlic and chilli.
Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.
Toss the prawns over high heat.
Add the butter, verjuice and parsley. Serve with the baguette for the juices.

Mason's single malt Rob Roy.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and chill the coupes; stir with the grape juice over ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool completely. Chill the coupes meanwhile.
Stir 200ml of the smoked tea with the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and vanilla over ice until icy.
Strain into the coupes, drop in a cherry and twist orange peel over each.

Frozen orange juice shots.make_ahead: Chill the juice and the glasses up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; blend with the ice and pour straight away

steps.text: Blend the juice and ice until slushy.
Pour into shot glasses and serve straight away.

Mimosa.make_ahead: Squeeze the oranges up to 1 day ahead and chill the juice; top with the alcohol-free sparkling wine just before serving

steps.text: Squeeze the oranges and chill the juice well.
Fill four flutes halfway with juice and gently top with the alcohol-free sparkling wine, pouring slowly.

Tarragon cream chicken with potato grati.n: Tarragon cream chicken with potato gratin
Tarragon cream chicken with potato grati.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer with part of the cream and the garlic and bake at 160C.
Pan-roast the chicken breasts until cooked through.
Add the stock, lemon juice, Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then the remaining cream, and simmer.
Steam the beans.
Serve together.

Reception French 75.make_ahead: Chill the alcohol-free sparkling wine up to 1 day ahead; shake each drink to order

steps.text: Chill the alcohol-free sparkling wine for three hours.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into flutes and top slowly with the sparkling wine.
Add a long twist of lemon peel and raise them high while someone gives a speech.

Espresso with anisette.make_ahead: Make the anise syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep it chilled; brew the espresso fresh

steps.text: Simmer the star anise, sugar and water for 5 minutes for an anise syrup, then strain and cool.
Brew four short espressos into warmed demitasse cups.
Cut four small curls of lemon peel, avoiding the white pith.
Serve the anise syrup beside each cup for pouring in, with a lemon curl.

Keep off the moors mulled ale.n: Keep off the moors mulled ale (alcohol-free)
Keep off the moors mulled ale.make_ahead: Best heated just before serving; keep warm on the lowest heat for up to 1 hour

steps.text: Pour the ale into a saucepan with the sugar, cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and nutmeg.
Heat gently, keeping it well under a simmer.
Stir in the apple juice and vanilla.
Strain into heatproof mugs and serve steaming.

Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball.n: Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball (alcohol-free)
Jack Cates' rye and ginger highball.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Fill highball glasses with ice and pour in the cold tea.
Add a squeeze of lemon and a drop of vanilla extract to each.
Top with ginger ale, stir once and add a strip of lemon peel.

Asgardian honey mead punch.make_ahead: Syrup up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the chamomile tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool.
Warm the honey with the water, cinnamon and cloves until the honey melts.
Cool and strain the syrup.
In a jug, mix the grape juice, chamomile tea, honey syrup and lemon juice.
Add plenty of ice, top with ginger beer and pour into glasses with orange slices.

Milk punch.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea, then mix with the milk, sugar syrup and vanilla up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake with ice and strain to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Shake the cold tea, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla hard with ice, a drink at a time.
Strain into chilled coupes and grate nutmeg over the top.

Rosewood's tequila sunrise.make_ahead: Squeeze the orange juice and lime and chill up to 1 day ahead; stir and pour the grenadine just before serving

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice. Add orange juice and a squeeze of lime to each and stir.
Slowly pour grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks. Do not stir again.
Garnish with an orange wheel and a cherry.
Chill the coupes and the bottle.
Drop a sugar cube into each glass, grate a little orange zest over it and add a drop of vanilla extract. Add the grape juice.
Tilt the glass and pour the sparkling slowly down the side so it does not foam over.
Peel long strips of lemon zest, twist over the drinks to spray the oil and drop them in.

1995 fuzzy navel slushies.make_ahead: Blend to order so it stays thick; chill the glasses, orange juice and peach nectar up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Blend the peaches, orange juice, peach nectar, lime juice and ice until thick and slushy.
Pour into chilled glasses and top each with a cherry and an orange wheel.

Gabe Walker's hot buttered rum.make_ahead: Beat the spiced butter up to 1 week ahead in the fridge; steep the tea and build the mugs just before serving

steps.text: Beat the butter with the sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, molasses and vanilla.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 3 minutes, then remove.
Put a heaped tablespoon of the spiced butter in each mug.
Top with the hot tea and stir until melted.

Logan's whisky and ginger highball.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice and top with ginger ale to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Put big ice cubes into tall glasses.
Pour in the cold tea, a little lime juice and a drop of vanilla extract.
Top slowly with cold ginger ale, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

Heatwave lager and lemonade shandy.make_ahead: Lemonade up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the lemons and stir the juice with the sugar and cold water until dissolved. Keep a few lemon wheels for the glasses.
Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer.
Half-fill each glass with ice-cold alcohol-free lager, top with lemonade, then add ice and a lemon wheel. Serve straight away.

Mixed-up guitar case michelada beer.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead; pour the alcohol-free lager at the last minute so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Run a lime wedge around four tall glasses and dip the rims in the chilli salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire sauce to each glass.
Top with cold alcohol-free lager, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

Franck's reception chicken with tarragon.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, sear the chicken fresh

steps.text: Halve the potatoes and dice the shallot.
Roast the potatoes in the oil at 220C.
Season the chicken breasts and sear skin-side down in a hot pan.
Flip and roast at 200C, then rest the chicken.
Fry the shallot in the pan, add the stock and lemon juice and reduce, then add the cream, Dijon and tarragon and simmer.
Cook the beans and toss in butter.
Serve with the potatoes.

Grapefruit pale ale radler.make_ahead: Chill the glasses in the freezer and the ale in the fridge up to 1 day ahead; mix the grapefruit soda and pour to serve

steps.text: Chill the pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Mix the juice of the pink grapefruit with the sugar syrup and the cold soda water.
Pour the cold alcohol-free pale ale into each glass, then top with the grapefruit soda.
Add a squeeze of lime and a grapefruit wedge.

Red wine, opened early.make_ahead: Mix and chill an hour before dinner

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes for a strong tea, then remove and cool.
Mix the grape juice, tea and balsamic vinegar in a carafe an hour before dinner and chill.
Pour into short tumblers at the table.

Club champagne cocktail.make_ahead: Best built to order; zest the orange up to 1 day ahead and chill the sparkling wine

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes with a drop of vanilla extract and a little grated orange zest.
Top slowly with chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each.

Glengoolie Blue whisky sour.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea up to 2 days ahead and make the honey syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep both chilled; shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the honey into the hot water and cool to make a syrup.
Shake 240ml of the smoked tea, the lemon juice, honey syrup and egg white in a jar without ice. Repeat for each drink.
Add ice and shake hard again, then strain into short glasses over a large ice cube.
Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.

Fourth of July bourbon lemonade.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea and mix the lemonade up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crush the berries and add ice on the night

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Squeeze four of the lemons, keeping one for wheels, and stir into the syrup and cold water.
Lightly crush the strawberries and blueberries in the bottom of four jars.
Fill with ice, add the cold tea and vanilla and top with the lemonade.
Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint.

Quint's chilli lime lager michelada.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; build each glass with cold alcohol-free lager to order

steps.text: Mix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.
Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.
Add lime juice, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce and tomato juice to each glass.
Top each with cold alcohol-free lager, stir once and crush the can.

Gin martini.make_ahead: Chill the non-alcoholic gin and freeze the glasses up to 1 day ahead; stir over ice to order

steps.text: Stir the non-alcoholic gin over ice for 10 seconds per drink and strain into frozen glasses.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.

Eight days to go whiskey sour.n: Eight days to go whiskey sour (alcohol-free)
Eight days to go whiskey sour.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; shake with the lemon, syrup and egg whites to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Shake 240ml of the tea with the lemon juice, syrup, vanilla and egg whites hard without ice to foam.
Add a big handful of ice and shake again.
Strain into tumblers over fresh ice.
Dust a little cinnamon over the foam and add a cherry.

Pepper's Villa Donna ouzo.make_ahead: Make the anise syrup up to 1 week ahead, strain it and keep in the fridge. Build each glass over ice to order

steps.text: Simmer the star anise, sugar and water for 5 minutes for an anise syrup, then strain and cool.
Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Pour a spoonful of anise syrup into each.
Top with lemonade and a mint sprig.

Elderflower and strawberry gin punch.make_ahead: Crush the strawberries with the sugar up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; add the non-alcoholic gin, cordial, lemon juice, ice and sparkling water just before serving

steps.text: Crush the strawberries with the sugar in a jug and leave for 15 minutes.
Add the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice and stir.
Fill the jug with ice and top with sparkling water. Pour into glasses with a few edible flowers on top.
Separate the eggs and whisk the yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk and cream, pour over the yolks and stir over low heat to 75C.
Chill overnight.
Stir in the vanilla and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

Mitch's house bourbon lemonade punch.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea, then mix the base up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add ice and the alcohol-free lager just before serving

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the cold tea, lemon juice, syrup, peach nectar and vanilla in a big bowl.
Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with the alcohol-free lager.
Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.

Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy.n: Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy (alcohol-free)
Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy.make_ahead: Freeze the pint glasses up to 1 day ahead; pour the lager and apple juice at the last minute

ingredients.item: bottles alcohol-free lager, 200ml needed per glass

steps.text: Put four pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour cold alcohol-free lager into each, then top slowly with chilled sparkling apple juice.
Add a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of green apple and serve straight away.

Blue Oyster blue lagoon.make_ahead: Warm, strain and cool the blue syrup up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the lemon juice and ice to order

steps.text: Warm the sugar syrup with the zest of the orange for 5 minutes, strain, cool and stir in the blue food colouring.
Fill tall glasses with ice.
Shake the blue syrup and lemon juice with ice and strain into the glasses.
Top with lemonade, stir once and garnish with a lemon wheel and a cherry.

Douglas Sirk steak.make_ahead: Season the steaks an hour ahead

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the beef stock and let it bubble, then add the cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

Double Deuce bourbon and ginger.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build each drink over ice on the night

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Pour the cold tea into each and squeeze in a lime wedge.
Add a drop of vanilla extract to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir gently once and garnish with a fresh lime wedge.
Slice the onions.
Simmer the bratwurst in the alcohol-free beer with the onions and butter.
Lift out the brats and grill, turning, until charred.
Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky.
Toast the rolls.
Fill with a brat and a pile of beer onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.

Coffee Black's espresso martini.make_ahead: Pull the espresso and cool it up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; chill the coupes and shake with the cold brew and ice to order

ingredients.item: espresso coffee beans, enough for 4 double shots

steps.text: Chill the coupes.
Pull four double shots of espresso from the beans and cool for 5 minutes.
For each drink, shake the espresso, cold brew, brown sugar syrup and vanilla hard with lots of ice for 15 seconds until foamy.
Strain into the glass and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the mushrooms, thyme, lemon juice and 200ml of the stock and braise.
Cook the rice with the butter and remaining stock for a pilaf.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve with the pilaf.

Water elemental seafood spaghetti.make_ahead: Best made fresh; crush the garlic and chop the parsley up to 1 day ahead, then add the stock and seafood on the night

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.
Soften the garlic and chilli in the olive oil.
Add the fish stock, lemon juice, prawns, mussels and clams, cover and cook until the shells open, discarding any that stay shut.
Toss through the spaghetti and parsley.

Paso doble sangria.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add the soda just before serving

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Slice the orange, lemon and apple and mix in a jug with the grape juice, tea and orange juice.
Chill for 2 hours so the flavours come together.
Top with the soda water and pour over ice.
Brown the brisket and soften the onions.
Add the grape juice, vinegar, stock and tomato paste.
Braise covered at 160C.
Add the carrots and roast for the last 40 minutes.
Slice the meat across the grain.
Juice the lemons and limes and mix with the sugar syrup.
Chill four pot glasses in the freezer.
Pour a measure of the citrus syrup into each glass, add soda water, then top slowly with cold alcohol-free lager. Stir once and add a lemon wedge.

Blondie's rye old fashioned.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea and make the syrup up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir over ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the sugar with the hot water until dissolved, then cool.
Stir 240ml of the smoked tea with the syrup, vanilla and a little grated orange zest over ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass.
Twist orange peel over the top and drop it in.
Cook part of the sugar to a dark caramel and pour into a loaf tin.
Whisk the eggs, remaining sugar, milk, cocoa, crushed amaretti and espresso.
Pour over and bake in a water bath at 160C.
Chill and turn out.

Island apple cider toddy from the teapot.n: Island apple cider toddy from the teapot (alcohol-free)
Island apple cider toddy from the teapot.make_ahead: Simmer the apple juice with the spices up to 1 day ahead and keep in the fridge; reheat, steep the tea and finish on the night

steps.text: Pour the apple juice and water into a saucepan with the honey, lemon zest, cinnamon and cloves.
Warm gently for 10 minutes without boiling.
Take off the heat, steep the tea bags for 3 minutes, then remove and stir in half the lemon juice.
Warm a teapot with hot water, tip it out, strain the toddy into the pot and pour into teacups at the table.

Rooftop ginger beer shandy.make_ahead: Put the glasses in the freezer up to 1 day ahead; slice the ginger and build the drinks just before serving

ingredients.item: bottles alcohol-free lager (375 ml each), cold

steps.text: Put 4 glasses in the freezer to chill.
Slice the ginger into thin coins and cut the limes into wedges.
Pour alcohol-free lager into each glass, top with ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins.

MacReady's Rob Roy.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir with the other ingredients and ice to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool.
Chill four coupe or rocks glasses.
Stir 240ml of the smoked tea with the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and vanilla with plenty of ice in a jug.
Strain into the glasses and drop in a cherry. Serve over one big ice block for anyone who likes it on the rocks.

Night-feed bourbon milk punch.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the milk, syrup, vanilla and ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, remove and cool.
Shake 160ml of the cold tea with the milk, syrup and vanilla with ice until frothy.
Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses.
Grate nutmeg over the top.

Mars red blood orange martini.make_ahead: If blood oranges are out of season, use orange juice and a splash of grenadine

steps.text: Chill four coupes. Squeeze four blood oranges for juice, grate a little zest from one, and juice the lime.
Shake the blood orange juice and zest, grape juice, sugar syrup and a little lime juice with ice.
Strain into the coupes and garnish with a thin wheel cut from the last blood orange.

Green poncho honey ginger tea.make_ahead: Simmer the ginger water up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; reheat, steep the tea and finish on the night

steps.text: Simmer the ginger in the water, then take off the heat and let it cool for a couple of minutes.
Add the tea bags and steep, then remove.
Stir in the honey and juice of one lemon.
Pour into mugs with a slice of the other lemon in each.

Wishing stone champagne cocktail.make_ahead: Nothing to cook; chill the alcohol-free sparkling wine, grape juice and flutes up to 1 day ahead and build each glass to order

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each flute with a little grated orange zest and a drop of vanilla extract.
Pour alcohol-free sparkling wine for the grown-ups or sparkling grape juice for the kids. Be careful what you wish for.

Lincoln saloon rye old fashioned.make_ahead: Steep and cool the smoked tea and make the demerara syrup up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir each drink with ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the sugar into the hot water to make a syrup and cool.
For each drink, stir 60ml of the smoked tea, syrup, a drop of vanilla and a little grated orange zest with ice until very cold.
Strain over a large ice cube in a short glass.
Squeeze a wide strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in.
